method.with_skill: an agent loaded the repository SKILL.md and relevant references or scripts before acting
method.baseline: an independent agent received the same request and identical starting fixture without the skill
method.fixture_policy: isolated temporary Markdown vaults with identical starting bytes
method.acceptance_boundary: real agent decisions, filesystem writes or refusals, profile inspection or proposal tooling, and byte-level preservation checks

integration_coverage: routing and nearest-style precedence across directory boundaries
supplement fragmentation and safe inlining across linked files
device-local profile inspection and non-mutating preference proposals
refusal boundary between note writing and note-healthcheck
observed_difference: Across every authored eval, the skill passed 15/15 compared with 4/15 for baseline. The largest differences were safe supplement handling, explicit-path routing, style precedence, non-invention, preference proposal discipline, and preservation of existing author material.
limitations: Agent outputs can vary across runs and model versions.
The suite used more than one available model route because one provider rate-limited an initial eval 10 attempt; the final eval 10 evidence comes from two independent successful live agents.
Fixtures exercised the repository skill, references, scripts, and filesystem integrations, but not installation through a future MOZAK release payload.
